title: Do MLLMs Really See It: Reinforcing Visual Attention in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2602.08241v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, existing approaches largely rely on long textual reasoning trajectories and provide limited mechanisms for learning stable visual attention policies. Our analysis shows that current MLLMs exhibit weak visual focus: early-stage visual misalignment is rarely corrected during subsequent reasoning, leading to error propagation and failed inferences. We argue that this limitation stems from inadequate credit assignment for visual attention during training. To address this issue, we propose SAYO, a visual reasoning model trained with a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that introduces a region-level visual attention-based reward. This reward explicitly aligns optimization signals with visually grounded reasoning steps, enabling the model to learn more reliable attention behaviors. Extensive experiments

translated_title: 多模态大语言模型真的看见了吗：强化多模态大语言模型中的视觉注意力
translated_abstract: 尽管思维链推理已在复杂推理任务上显著提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的表现，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖于冗长的文本推理轨迹，并且缺乏学习稳定视觉注意力策略的机制。我们的分析表明，当前的MLLM表现出较弱的视觉聚焦能力：早期阶段出现的视觉错位在后续推理过程中很少被纠正，从而导致错误传播和推理失败。我们认为这一局限源于训练过程中对视觉注意力的信用分配不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SAYO，一个通过强化学习（RL）框架训练的视觉推理模型，该框架引入了基于区域级视觉注意力的奖励。该奖励显式地将优化信号与基于视觉的推理步骤对齐，使模型能够学习到更可靠的注意力行为。大量实验……
tldr: 提出SAYO模型，通过在强化学习框架中引入区域级视觉注意力奖励，解决多模态大语言模型视觉聚焦弱、早期视觉错位无法在推理中被纠正的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes SAYO, an RL-trained visual reasoning model that introduces a region-level visual attention-based reward, addressing weak visual focus in MLLMs by aligning optimization signals with visually grounded reasoning steps.
